evidence.summary: Checked Nvidia’s November 8 and November 12 primary statements and Huang’s published employee message, with Reuters and CNN reporting. The resignation and interim appointment are confirmed; intelligence and relationship allegations remain precisely attributed.
evidence.limits: Limited AI-assisted documentary check, not human review or a full fact-check. No sealed intelligence, investigative findings, original New York Times retrieval, interviews, closing-market reconstruction or forecast validation.
